q: Is electricity from a Nigerian cement plant's own gas turbines Scope 1 or Scope 2?
title: Nigerian cement captive power: scope
short: If the plant owns or controls the turbines, the gas burnt is Scope 1, and there is no Scope 2 for that power. Only power bought from the grid or a third party is Scope 2. Report the gas by volume and heat content from the supply invoices or meters, with the factor and its source.
audience: Cement and other heavy industry in Nigeria running captive gas or diesel power

p: Control decides it. A turbine you own and run is your Scope 1. An independent power producer on your site selling you electricity is Scope 2.
Diesel generators you own are Scope 1 as well. Keep their fuel separate so the backup share is visible.
Gas supply invoices or meter readings with heating value, generator fuel logs and any grid bills.
